title: eriogonum brevicaule subsp. typicum
intro: Eriogonum brevicaule subsp. typicum, commonly known as Short-stemmed Buckwheat Salsify, is a plant species in the Buckwheat family. It is a flowering plant native to the Great Basin region of North America. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum brevicaule subsp. typicum include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
